visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Duplicate Maximum Counts Twice
visualizerParams.problemDescription: In 20, 20, 10, 5 the second largest distinct value is 10, but the program prints 20.

solution.explanation: When the second 20 arrives it is not larger than first, but it is larger than second (-1), so it is stored as second. The extra test a[i] != first rejects values equal to the maximum.
